info.title: Phone & Accessory Shop API
info.description: Backend for a small retail shop: phones, accessories, sales, debts, expenses and statistics. Multi-tenant — all data scoped by shop.

inviteCode.description: Required only when the server sets INVITE_CODE

refreshToken.description: The raw refresh token issued at login/refresh

name.description: Do'kon nomi — printed on the label

labelFooter.description: Footer text printed at the bottom of the label

imei.description: Optional. Digits only, 10–20 chars when provided.

salePrice.description: Actual sold price (sotilgan narx) for a SOLD phone, from its sale; null while IN_STOCK

profit.description: salePrice - purchasePrice for a SOLD phone; null otherwise

imei.description: Optional. Digits only, 10–20 chars when provided.

memory.description: Omitted when both ram and storage are null

costPrice.description: Cost snapshot for these units (olingan narx)

quantity.description: Units sold at this price, net of returns

profit.description: Profit net of returns: sum (unitPrice - costPrice) * (qty - returnedQty)

unitPrice.description: Defaults to the accessory salePrice when omitted

amount.description: Refund amount. Defaults to the proportional sold amount; may be lower, never higher.

productName.description: Comma-joined product names on the sale

saleTotalAmount.description: Total amount of the underlying sale

paidAmount.description: Amount already paid on the sale

grossProfit.description: phone profit + accessory profit, net of returns

cashIn.description: sale paidAmount + debts settled within range
